summary: Frontier Nuclear and Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 14, 2026, announcing the launch of a 2026 drill program at its 100% owned Pine Ridge uranium project in Wyoming. The program includes approximately 120 holes totaling ~36,000 meters, running from July through December 2026, with potential extension into January 2027, aiming to generate a maiden mineral resource estimate by early 2027. While a strategic milestone, the filing describes routine operational activity with no change in corporate control, capital structure, or shareholder actions, thus it does not constitute a special situation.
